name: pinned-curobo-v2-portable-dropin-parity
goal: Every upstream user-observable behavior that can exist on Apple Silicon executes against the installed curobo-metal wheel; mechanism-only CUDA exclusions are narrow and case-specific.

permitted: Replace an exact Python string literal equal to cuda with mps.
Replace an exact Python string literal equal to cuda:0 with mps:0.
Replace an exact torch.cuda.is_available() gate with torch.backends.mps.is_available() in test modules.
Replace an exact zero-argument torch.cuda.synchronize() timing barrier with torch.mps.synchronize() outside reviewed CUDA-mechanism cases.
Replace an assertion-scoped Tensor.is_cuda residency check with an exact device.type == 'mps' check after device substitution.
In the pinned DeviceCfg module only, adapt the no-argument default oracle to the available MPS/CPU portable default and compare normalized CPU/MPS index zero with DeviceCfg.is_same_torch_device.
Redirect an exact import of an unshipped pinned-upstream example helper to an identically sourced non-shadowing staged helper module.

Guard the pinned voxel-collision module's test-only raw Warp registration and kernel declarations behind the original CUDA availability check so its adjacent VoxelData construction cases can collect and execute on MPS.
forbidden: Changing assertions, tolerances, test parameters, or expected values except the exact assertion-scoped Tensor.is_cuda and pinned DeviceCfg portability-oracle adaptations permitted above.
Renaming or emulating CUDA graph, CUDA stream, CUDA event, or Warp APIs.
Adding skip or xfail markers outside a reviewed case-level mechanism exclusion.
